rationale: Reduce each 3x3 block to its most common colour including zero: demonstration 2 maps three 2s to 0 and seven 2s to 2.
Each vertical pair becomes 5 if either cell is nonzero; demonstration 1 maps [0,3] to 5 and [0,0] to 0.
Each 3x3 block returns its most common nonzero colour, or 0 when empty; all three demonstrations agree.
Each 2x2 block returns its most common colour including zero; demonstration 1 maps two zeros and two 2s to 0, and three 3s to 3.
Each horizontal pair becomes 5 when occupied; demonstration 1 maps [0,1] and [3,0] to 5, and [0,0] to 0.
Each vertical pair returns its nonzero colour, ignoring background; demonstration 3 maps [0,3] to 3 and [0,0] to 0.
Each 2x2 block becomes 5 if any cell is nonzero; demonstration 2 includes single occupied cells mapping to 5 and empty blocks mapping to 0.
Each 2x2 block returns its most common nonzero colour; demonstration 1 maps a block containing one 1 and three zeros to 1.
Each 2x3 block returns its most common colour including background; demonstration 1 maps three 2s and three zeros to 0, while solid 2 blocks become 2.
Each horizontal pair returns its most common nonzero colour; demonstration 1 maps [1,0] to 1, [2,0] to 2, and [0,0] to 0.
